company.name: Laimoon
company.shortDescription: Laimoon is a discovery platform that helps individuals find courses, jobs, and professional development advice.
company.description: Laimoon supports career-minded people with information on jobs,courses and career insights. Currently focussing on the UAE and the wider GCC region. Laimoon is a Dubai-based career and education platform founded in 2011. It helps users discover professional courses, certifications, training programs, and job opportunities across multiple industries. Serving millions of users globally, Laimoon partners with training providers to support career growth, skill development, and recruitment solutions in over 30 countries.
